correctness.rationale: For odd n≥7, gcd(n²,(n+2)²)=1. Verified all three polynomial reduction relations with positive multiples of a=n² and nonnegative coefficients. They strictly reduce any x b + y c from x≥n+2, y≥n+2 or upper-right forbidden rectangle into T_n; termination by decreasing positive weight. T_n has (n+2)²−8(n+1)/2=n² points, and every residue occurs by reducing nonnegative multiples of b; hence distinct minimal Apéry representatives. Its two maximal coordinate corners are (n−7,n+1) and (n+1,(n+1)/2), giving precisely two pseudo-Frobenius numbers; summing rectangle coordinates and applying genus Apéry sum identity gives closed genus. Cubic PF difference changes order after n=11 for odd n. Independently ran Dijkstra minimal representatives and PF/genus for n=7,9,11,13,15,17,19,31,51 and all matched, finite check not used as infinite proof.
